use_case: Rate suggestions from the innkeeping software's AI add-on (SYS-11), applied automatically to the calendar, booking engine, and OTA rates
vendor_or_model: Innkeeping software vendor (AI add-on; demand forecasting model using the inn's booking history and public OTA rates)
data_categories: Booking and rate history; occupancy; public competitor rates (no guest identities)
human_in_the_loop: Today none: suggestions auto-apply. Condition: floor, ceiling, and 15% daily change limit; owner approves anything outside; auto-apply off during a declared state of emergency
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 464.2 (total price in every display); FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); Fla. Stat. 501.160 (unconscionable prices during a declared state of emergency)

use_case: Guest chat assistant from the same AI add-on (SYS-11) on the inn website: answers questions and quotes rates and availability, then links to the booking engine
vendor_or_model: Innkeeping software vendor (AI add-on; generative language model)
data_categories: Guest questions, names, emails; chat transcripts (4 found with card numbers)
human_in_the_loop: Owner reads 10 transcripts a week; chat hands booking changes, accessibility, and safety questions to the owner
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 464.2 and 464.3; FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.2 and 4.2 (card numbers typed into chat); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (transcripts hold personal information; vendor is a third-party agent)
status: In production; fee and masking conditions due 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-31
